series.name: HACIPUPU|One Day in Kasukabe Series Figures
series.note: My Favorite Cookie (177g) is heaviest, Wake Up Refreshed (96.76g) is lightest. [Secret] ACTION! Kiddie Ride (134.32g).

figures.name: The Kindergarten Newcomer
figures.feel: Up/down shaking causes noticeable overall box hits with rattling and clunking sounds. Front/back has limited space but a clear clunk. Left/right barely moves, with only a tiny bit of space and very slight box hits. A faint bag sound can be heard when pressing front/back. The figure can be felt from the left/right but does not press against the box and can still move. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: Wake Up Refreshed
figures.feel: Up/down shaking causes slight overall box hits with mild clunking and clicking sounds. Front/back has slight box hits with a faint bag sound. Left/right has only a tiny bit of space with very slight figure movement and a clear card-clicking sound. An obvious bag sound can be heard when pressing front/back, with a slight bag sound from the left/right. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: In Shiro's House
figures.feel: The figure barely moves up/down, but the granular sound from the desiccant pack is very obvious. Front/back also barely moves, with clear clicking and granular sounds from the desiccant. Left/right does not move, with obvious card-clicking and granular sounds. The desiccant pack and part of the figure can be felt from the left/right but do not press against the box. A bag sound can be heard when pressing front/back. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: ACTION! Kiddie Ride (Secret)
figures.feel: The figure does not move at all up/down, but the desiccant pack hits the box. Front/back also barely moves, with only slight movement and a granular sound from the desiccant. Left/right has slight box hits with limited space and a bag sound. An obvious bag sound can be heard when pressing all six sides.

figures.name: Good Day
figures.feel: Up/down shaking causes noticeable overall box hits with limited space and a clunking feel. Front/back has only a tiny bit of space with slight box hits and mild clunking. Left/right also has only a tiny bit of space, with rattling and slight clunking. The figure can be felt near the bottom when pressing front/back but does not press against the box. A bag sound can be heard when pressing left/right and top/bottom.

figures.name: My Favorite Cookie
figures.feel: There is only a tiny bit of up/down space. The figure is completely immovable front/back and left/right, with only slight card movement. The figure presses firmly against the box when pressing front/back or left/right. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: My Mood's Rainproof
figures.feel: Up/down shaking causes noticeable overall box hits with a clunking feel. Front/back also hits the box with limited space and clear clunking. Left/right has strong box hits with an obvious clunking sound. A bag sound can be heard when pressing front/back and left/right. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: The Best Decision
figures.feel: There is very slight up/down figure movement with only a tiny bit of space; the desiccant pack noticeably rubs against and hits the box. The figure does not move front/back, but the desiccant makes a clear granular sound. The figure does not move left/right either, but there is a clear card-clicking sound. An obvious bag sound can be heard when pressing front/back and left/right. Nothing can be felt from the top/bottom.

figures.name: An Extraordinary Day
figures.feel: There is lots of movement in every direction, with strong overall box hits. The desiccant and accessories are both very loud when shaken.

figures.name: It's Buriburizaemon Costume
figures.feel: Slight front/back movement with a desiccant sound. Left/right shaking causes the accessory and card to hit the box. Up/down shaking produces dull thudding box hits at the bottom.

figures.name: Time for a Break
figures.feel: Overall box hits when shaken front/back, with an obvious desiccant sound. Left/right shaking produces a very loud desiccant sound, clearly coming from the upper part of the box. There is lots of up/down space, with heavy bottom box hits.

figures.name: Where It All Begins
figures.feel: There is almost no movement in any direction and the box feels very full. The figure presses firmly against the lower-middle area on the front, back, left, and right sides.

figures.name: To Save the World
figures.feel: Front/back shaking causes box hits around the upper-middle area. Left/right shaking produces strong overall box hits with an obvious creaking sound. There is limited up/down space with dull, heavy thudding sounds.

series.name: Twinkle Twinkle | Farm Tales Series - Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Wild Cowboy (162.79g) is heaviest, Pure Pigling (140.12g) is lightest. [Secret ID] Tearful Duckling (148.9g): Feels quite full overall. The tail of the hat makes a distinctive sandbag-like rustling sound when shaken. All regular figures use small desiccant packs, so this extra rustling sound is the key giveaway.

figures.name: Pure Pigling
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. Up/Down: Noticeable box-hits with a clunking feel. Front/Back: Strong box-hits with obvious clunking and clicking sounds. Left/Right: Very obvious box-hits with clunking and clicking sounds. Nothing can be felt when pressing all six sides.

figures.name: Loyal Wolfy
figures.feel: Up/Down: Noticeable box-hits with a clear card-clicking sound. Front/Back: Strong box-hits and clunking. Left/Right: Strong box-hits with obvious clunking. Nothing can be felt when pressing all six sides.

figures.name: Fearless Pumpkin
figures.feel: Up/Down: The figure rubs and hits the box with clear clicking. Front/Back: Noticeable box-hits around the upper-middle area, also with clicking. Left/Right: Obvious box-hits especially around the upper-middle area, with a strong clunking feel. Slight clicking when pressing front/back; nothing can be felt from the other four sides.

figures.name: Tearful Duckling (Secret)
figures.feel: [Secret ID] Feels quite full overall. The tail of the hat makes a distinctive sandbag-like rustling sound when shaken (key identification clue). All regular figures use small desiccant packs, so this extra rustling sound makes the Secret relatively easy to identify.

figures.name: Warm Lamb
figures.feel: Up/Down: Limited space with box-hits and clear card-clicking. Front/Back: Limited space with rubbing and box-hits. Left/Right: Limited space with obvious clunking box-hits. Nothing can be felt when pressing all six sides.

figures.name: Faithful Puppy
figures.feel: Up/Down: The figure hits the box, with a clear clicking sound from the desiccant pack. Front/Back: Slight box-hits with limited space and a bag-rubbing sound. Left/Right: Strong box-hits with obvious clunking. Nothing can be felt when pressing all six sides.

figures.name: Wild Cowboy
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Up/Down: Box-hits with clicking and clunking sounds. Front/Back: The figure barely moves with only a tiny bit of space but a clear clicking sound. Left/Right: Slight box-hits with limited space and clicking. Nothing can be felt when pressing all six sides.

series.name: Act I|Sugar Therapy Room Series Figures
series.note: Syrup Jar (132.53g) is heaviest, 100% Good Apple (93.12g) is lightest. [Secret ID] Sweetness Generator (95g): Shakes evenly in all three directions with light box-hitting. Besides the desiccant sound, there is a distinct fine, dense granular rattling sound inside.

figures.name: 100% Good Apple
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. Up/Down: Tiny bit of space, with a rubbing-against-the-box sound. Front/Back: Tiny bit of space. Left/Right: Almost no movement, with only a faint sound. Faint bag crinkling from the front/back/top/bottom pressing; obvious bag crinkling from the left/right pressing.

figures.name: Sweet Prescription
figures.feel: Up/Down: Main figure does not move; accessory rubs against and hits the box with a clicking sound. Front/Back: Main figure does not move; desiccant hits the box with a clicking sound. Left/Right: Same as front/back. Nothing can be felt from any of the six sides when pressing.

figures.name: Sweetness Generator (Secret)
figures.feel: [Secret ID] Shakes evenly in all three directions with light box-hitting. Besides the desiccant sound, there is a distinct fine, dense granular rattling sound inside (key identification clue).

figures.name: Cavity Crying
figures.feel: Up/Down: Tiny bit of space. Front/Back: No movement, with a faint granular sound. Left/Right: Tiny bit of space with a faint clunking sound. Clear pressure point around the upper-middle front/back when pressing; nothing can be felt from the left/right/top/bottom.

figures.name: Hard Candy Hypnosis
figures.feel: Up/Down: Light box contact with a clunking sound. Front/Back: Hits the box with little space and a clunking sound. Left/Right: Light box contact with a rustling sound and faint clunking. Faint bag crinkling on all six sides when pressing.

figures.name: Doctor's Listening
figures.feel: Up/Down: Clearly hits the box with a bouncy feel. Front/Back: Light box contact with little space, a bouncy feel and bag crinkling. Left/Right: Clear box contact around the upper-middle area, with little space and a clunking sound. The bag can be felt from the front/back/left/right pressing; nothing from the top/bottom.

figures.name: Cherry Mill
figures.feel: Up/Down: Tiny bit of space with a faint clicking sound. Front/Back: Tiny bit of space. Left/Right: Main figure barely moves; accessory lightly hits the box with a faint clunk. Clear pressure point around the lower-middle front/back when pressing; bag crinkling from the left/right; nothing from the top/bottom.

figures.name: First Aid Ready
figures.feel: Up/Down: No movement, with a faint granular sound. Front/Back: Main figure does not move; desiccant lightly hits the box with a granular sound. Left/Right: Tiny bit of overall space and box contact, with a faint granular sound. Obvious bag crinkling on all six sides when pressing.

figures.name: Master Pastry Chef
figures.feel: Up/Down: Slight box contact. Front/Back: Almost no movement, with a faint clicking sound from the upper area. Left/Right: Slight box contact with a granular sound and faint clunking. Faint bag crinkling on all six sides when pressing.

figures.name: Clockwork Strawberry
figures.feel: Up/Down: Light box contact with a clunking sound. Front/Back: Hits the box with little space and a clunking sound. Left/Right: Light box contact with little space, a clunking sound and a faint swishing/clicking sound. Bag crinkling from the front/back/left/right pressing; nothing from the top/bottom.

figures.name: Sweetness Inspector
figures.feel: Up/Down: Main figure does not move; desiccant hits the box heavily with a granular sound. Front/Back: Main figure does not move; clear granular sound from the desiccant. Something can be felt from the front/back/left/right pressing, but it does not press firmly against the box; bag crinkling can also be heard. Nothing from the top/bottom.

figures.name: Creamy Sweetheart
figures.feel: Up/Down: Light box contact with little space and a faint clunking sound. Front/Back: Similar feel, with an additional rustling sound. Left/Right: Same as front/back. Nothing can be directly felt from any side when pressing, with only faint bag crinkling.

figures.name: Syrup Jar
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Up/Down: Almost no movement; accessory moves very slightly. Front/Back: Tiny bit of overall space and box contact, with a faint clicking sound from the accessory. Left/Right: Tiny bit of overall space and box contact. Slight pressure point near the bottom from front/back pressing; nothing from the left/right/top/bottom.

series.name: CHAKA|Stitch by Stitch Series Figures
series.note: Granny's Glasses (141.3g) is heaviest, has plastic shell. Secret Spinning Glamour (125.3g): Very tightly packed with a thick card inside, no hitting sound when shaking in any direction, slight top pressure on upper left/right sides. Lady Model (111.6g) is lightest.

figures.name: Lady Model
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. Up/Down: Upper accessory hits with a slight desiccant sound. Front/Back: Upper front main body and accessories hit. Left/Right: Only accessory hitting sound. (Medium desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Wandering Line
figures.feel: Front/Back: Rear middle and front lower areas hit, with desiccant sound. Left/Right: Light hit on the upper left side. Up/Down: Bottom accessory hits with a strong desiccant sound. (Large desiccant bag, large accessory)

figures.name: Dream in Embroidery
figures.feel: Up/Down: Large space; bottom accessory and desiccant hit with a noticeable sound. Front/Back: Heavy hit around the upper left-middle area. Left/Right: Only desiccant and identity card movement sounds; obvious pressure point on the right middle-left area. (Medium desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Safety Pin
figures.feel: Front/Back: Light hit on the upper rear side. Left/Right: Light hit around the left middle area. Up/Down: Main figure stays still; only accessories and desiccant move and hit strongly. (Large desiccant bag, large accessory)

figures.name: Precise Cutting
figures.feel: Up/Down: Only slight desiccant sound. Left/Right: Only desiccant hitting sound. Front/Back: Slight movement with an even shaking feeling, mainly desiccant sound. (Small desiccant bag)

figures.name: Time Iron
figures.feel: Left/Right: Lower left side hits with a heavier sound, accompanied by identity card noise. Front/Back: Upper front accessory hits lightly, lower front main body hits more noticeably. Up/Down: About 1.5 fingers of space, bottom lightly hits the box when shaking. (Medium desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Spinning Glamour (Secret)
figures.feel: [Secret ID] Very tightly packed with a thick card inside. No hitting sound when shaking in any direction. Slight top pressure can be felt on the upper left and right sides.

figures.name: Thimble Fort
figures.feel: Up/Down: Hits both top and bottom, with a stronger top impact. Left/Right: Light hit near the upper left corner on the right side. Front/Back: Light hit around the upper middle front area with a loud desiccant sound. (Large desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Yarn Chaser
figures.feel: Front/Back: Large movement space, with a strong hit around the rear middle area. Left/Right: Strong hit around the upper right/left area. Up/Down: Main body hits inside the box, with a loud desiccant sound. (Large desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Yarn Chaser (Perfect Eyes)
figures.feel: Up/Down: Large movement space; bottom hits heavily with a slight desiccant sound. Left/Right: Upper accessories on both sides hit; slight pressure point around the left middle-right area. Front/Back: Mainly desiccant sound; obvious pressure point on the front middle area. (Large desiccant bag, multiple accessories, slight button movement sound)

figures.name: Needle & Thread
figures.feel: Up/Down: About 1.5 fingers of space; bottom lightly hits when shaking. Left/Right: Heavy hit around the right middle-right area. Front/Back: Pressure points on the upper-left rear and middle front areas at the same time, with desiccant sound. (Small desiccant bag, with accessories)

figures.name: Click-Clack Time Machine
figures.feel: Up/Down: Very full, only slight desiccant and identity card sounds. Clear pressure point when pressing the top. Left/Right: Desiccant hits; slight bulging feeling around the right middle-left area. Front/Back: Slight pressure point on the lower right-middle rear area. (Small desiccant bag, no accessories)

figures.name: Granny's Glasses
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Left/Right: Heavy hit on the lower right side with desiccant sound. Up/Down: Very full, only desiccant sound; slight plastic shell sound when pressing. Front/Back: Slight movement with desiccant sound. (Large desiccant bag, large accessory, plastic shell)

series.name: Nyota|Chibi Maruko Chan Plush Doll Pendant
series.note: [Key Pick] My No.1 Friend (110g): Very heavy and very full. The whole box feels stretched and slightly moves when shaken. All six sides are packed tightly; when touching, you can feel the paper bag being fully stretched with a noticeable paper bag sound. Clear identification (easy to distinguish). Secret Here Comes the Wind (111.24g) is heaviest: almost no movement on all six sides, front squeeze clearly presses the middle, left/right squeeze no obvious top pressure but figure can be felt and box feels slightly bulged.

figures.name: Rest Day
figures.feel: All six sides have a little space, but there is no hitting or knocking sound. The desiccant sound is very noticeable.

figures.name: Marathons Are the Worst
figures.feel: Although it is small, the figure is still very tightly packed. No movement on all six sides.

figures.name: Daydreaming
figures.feel: Still very full on all six sides. There is a tiny amount of space up and down, but the figure does not move in other directions.

figures.name: I'm Rich
figures.feel: Very small space can be felt when shaking up and down and front/back. Left and right are very tight with no space.

figures.name: Sooo Lucky
figures.feel: Completely full on all six sides. Only the desiccant sound can be heard when shaking up and down.

figures.name: Grow Taller
figures.feel: The figure is completely fixed on all six sides. Only the desiccant bag can be heard moving up and down.

figures.name: That's My Sister
figures.feel: This figure has more accessories and a taller body. Even without a desiccant bag, it feels very full. The whole box feels slightly stretched. There is a slight top pressure feeling around the upper middle area on the left and right sides, but no obvious pressure point.

figures.name: My Name is Maruko
figures.feel: The whole figure feels slightly bulged. The desiccant bag is very small. All six sides are extremely full, with only a slight desiccant movement sound when shaking.

figures.name: The Best Grandpa
figures.feel: Still completely full on all six sides with no empty space.

figures.name: Eat Well
figures.feel: There is space and movement when shaking up and down. This one has a very large desiccant bag. The four side directions have no space.

figures.name: Focus on Sleep
figures.feel: Very full on all six sides. Only a slight loose desiccant movement can be felt. The large desiccant bag affects the hand feel.

figures.name: My No.1 Friend
figures.feel: [Key Pick] Very heavy and very full. The whole box feels stretched and slightly moves when shaken. All six sides are packed tightly; when touching, you can feel the paper bag being fully stretched with a noticeable paper bag sound. Clear identification (easy to distinguish).

figures.name: Here Comes the Wind (Secret)
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Up/Down: The figure almost does not move, only a slight desiccant particle sound. Front/Back: The figure does not move at all, with a slight desiccant particle sound. Left/Right: The figure does not move at all, with a desiccant particle sound. Front squeeze: The middle part clearly presses against the box. Left/Right squeeze: No obvious top pressure, but the figure can be felt and the box feels slightly bulged. Top/Bottom squeeze: Cannot feel the figure.

series.name: SKULLPANDA|OFF MODE Plush Doll Pendant Mini Size
series.note: Mini series has minimal weight/feel differences overall. [Key Pick] Mute Mode (100g): Hold upper part and rotate lower part - lower section is very full and tight, nearly 100% identifiable. Secret Self Mode (106g): Left/right almost completely locked, arms pressed against box wall. Low Battery (115g) is heaviest.

figures.name: Stay Chill
figures.feel: Up/Down: Very little space inside the box, but you can hear desiccant and key ring sounds. Left/Right: Desiccant and key ring sounds noticeable. Front/Back: A slight but obvious head bumping sound from the back side, with a clear impact point.

figures.name: No Adulting
figures.feel: All six directions have noticeable space. Space ranking: Up/Down > Left/Right > Front/Back. Strong impact feeling when shaking up and down, with obvious metal ring collision sounds.

figures.name: Soft Chaos
figures.feel: Clear box movement in all directions. The doll itself also moves noticeably when shaken vertically. Left/right sides have slight impact sounds, especially near the lower back area. Front/back: a more obvious impact point around the lower quarter area.

figures.name: Rest Day
figures.feel: Very large internal space in all directions. Strong shaking movement vertically. Clear and crisp impact sounds around the upper-middle area from front, back, left and right directions.

figures.name: Mask Off
figures.feel: Noticeable space and impact feeling when shaking up and down. Key ring sound is not very strong vertically, but very crisp when shaking left and right. Front/back have a softer, muffled impact feeling.

figures.name: Mute Mode
figures.feel: [Special ID method] Hold the upper part of the box and rotate/shake the lower part. The lower part of this figure is very full and tightly packed. When shaken normally, left/right feel completely filled with only a crisp key ring sound. Front/back have some space, and there is more room vertically. Using this method, it is almost 100% identifiable.

figures.name: Break Time
figures.feel: Very large space vertically, with strong movement from both the figure and key ring. Clear individual impact points in all directions. Front impact point: left side of the hair clip area, very noticeable.

figures.name: Slow Down
figures.feel: Very crisp and strong impact point around the center of the forehead area. Large vertical space. Overall loose feeling with noticeable movement in all six directions.

figures.name: Stay In
figures.feel: Noticeable desiccant and metal ring collision sounds when shaking vertically. The doll itself has little room, but slight movement can still be felt around the sides. Front/back impact point: upper rear quarter area.

figures.name: Not Now
figures.feel: Front/back: almost no movement. Left/right: large space with obvious metal collision sounds. Up/down: also has space, but the sounds mainly come from the metal ring rather than the doll.

figures.name: Hit Snooze
figures.feel: Extremely strong vertical impact feeling. Left/right: impact point around the middle area. Front/back: the doll's head hits the box, with stronger impact from the back side.

figures.name: Self Mode (Secret)
figures.feel: [Secret Pick] Left/right: almost completely locked. The doll's arms are pressed against the box wall, making it impossible to shake. Up/down: only a tiny amount of movement. Front/back: you can feel the soft top of the head lightly touching the box. Overall sound is soft and muffled, without any sharp or heavy impact.

figures.name: Low Battery
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Very little vertical space but still slightly movable. Left/right: completely locked with no extra space. Front/back: slight movement, stronger from the back side.

series.name: DIMOO WORLD|PIXAR Series - Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Secret Buzz Lightyear at 197.16g is heaviest overall. Red Panda Mei at 150.9g is lightest. Secret: upright front/back shake has strong hard impact at hair-hat brim junction, inverted left/right hits at secret figure guide area, front/back space ~2 fingers.

figures.name: DIMOO As Woody
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Vertical shake: Around 2-finger movement space, with clear bottom box tapping. Left/right shake: Large movement space. Noticeable tapping around Woody's name area on the artwork side, with symmetrical tapping on the opposite side. Front/back shake: Larger space compared with left/right. Strong tapping on the middle area of the back side.

figures.name: DIMOO As Sulley
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Around 2-finger movement space, with bottom box tapping. Left/right shake: Large movement space. Noticeable tapping around Sulley's name area on the artwork side. Front/back shake: Larger space compared with left/right. Strong tapping around the top area of DIMOO's hat on the front artwork side.

figures.name: DIMOO As Remy
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Slight movement only. Left/right shake: Small movement space, pay attention to tapping around the middle area of the artwork side. Front/back shake: Slight movement only.

figures.name: DIMOO As Dash Parr
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Around 2-finger movement space. Both upward and downward directions create box tapping sounds, but the sound is relatively soft. Left/right shake: Large movement space. Strong tapping at the top of Sulley's head area on the artwork side, with symmetrical tapping at the opposite position. Front/back shake: Large movement space. Strong tapping where DIMOO's head and hat meet on the front artwork side, with tapping at the same position on the back side.

figures.name: DIMOO As Lotso
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Cannot feel movement. Left/right shake: Small movement space. Noticeable tapping around Sulley's head area on the artwork side. Front/back shake: Completely locked with no obvious movement.

figures.name: DIMOO As Red Panda Mei
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. Vertical shake: Around 2-finger movement space, with tapping in both directions. Left/right shake: Large movement space. Noticeable tapping around Sulley's head area on the artwork side. Front/back shake: Large movement space. Strong tapping around DIMOO's hat area on the front artwork side, with additional tapping around the middle area of the back side.

figures.name: DIMOO As Buzz Lightyear (Secret)
figures.feel: Front/back shake (normal direction): Strong hard tapping sound at the connection area between the hair and hat brim (see P4). The impact area is relatively large and requires a firm hard hit to identify. Front/back shake (upside down): Hard tapping around slightly below the "XA" area of the PIXAR logo. Left/right shake (normal direction): No obvious tapping from the spaceship accessory. Left/right shake (upside down): Hard tapping appears around the secret artwork area. Back middle area: The hanging ring may hit the box and create a sound, but it is not obvious. Movement space: Up/down more than 1 finger, Left/right more than 1 finger, Front/back around 2 fingers.

series.name: DIMOO|PIXAR Series - Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Buzz Lightyear at 171.8g is heaviest and completely locked. Dash Parr at 119.0g is lightest. Secret Space Crane at 130g only makes silica packet sounds, middle-lower area feels extremely full - easy identify box.

figures.name: DIMOO As Buzz Lightyear
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Vertical shake: Completely locked, with only very faint silica packet particle sounds. Front/back shake: Completely immobile, with silica packet particle sounds. Left/right shake: Completely immobile, with obvious silica packet particle sounds. Squeeze test: The lower-middle area can feel the figure but does not press against the box. The lower-middle sides have obvious bulging pressure. Top and bottom also have a pressed-against feeling.

figures.name: DIMOO As Sulley
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Completely immobile, only silica packet particle sounds can be heard. Front/back shake: A tiny amount of movement space with slight box tapping. Left/right shake: Very small movement space with slight tapping and faint silica packet sounds. Squeeze test: The middle area can feel the figure inside but does not press against the box. All sides have slight bag sounds. (Double-layer bag)

figures.name: DIMOO As Lotso
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Slight overall box tapping, heavy hand feel, with bag sounds. Front/back shake: Clear clunking around the upper-middle area, but movement space is limited. Left/right shake: Very slight overall tapping with a faint clunk. Squeeze test: The lower-middle area can feel the object inside with obvious pressure. Side squeezing produces bag sounds. Top and bottom cannot be squeezed, but the box does not feel empty.

figures.name: DIMOO As Woody
figures.feel: Vertical shake: The figure is almost fixed, but the card rubbing against the box creates clicking sounds. Front/back shake: Slight tapping around the upper-middle area with a soft clunk. Left/right shake: Very slight overall movement with a rustling sound. Squeeze test: Front/back cannot feel the figure. The sides can slightly feel the figure but it does not press against the box. Bag sounds are noticeable. Top and bottom cannot be squeezed, but the box does not feel empty.

figures.name: DIMOO As Alien
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Almost no movement, with only very slight silica packet particle sounds. Front/back shake: Completely locked, with faint silica packet particle sounds. Left/right shake: The figure is completely fixed, but the silica packet rubs and taps against the box. Squeeze test: The middle area has a clear hard feeling when pressed. The lower-middle area on both sides has slight bag sounds. Top and bottom cannot be squeezed.

figures.name: DIMOO As Hamm
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Very slight figure movement, mainly with bag rubbing sounds. Front/back shake: Slight overall movement with bag sounds. Left/right shake: Slight movement with a rustling sound. Squeeze test: All six sides have slight bag sounds.

figures.name: DIMOO As Red Panda Mei
figures.feel: Vertical shake: The figure itself is almost completely locked in place, but the card hitting the box creates clear clicking sounds. Front/back shake: Overall box tapping with limited movement space, accompanied by a slight clunking feeling and rubbing sounds. Left/right shake: The figure barely moves, but the card tapping sound is noticeable. Squeeze test: Front and back/top squeezes have very slight bag sounds. The figure can be slightly felt when squeezing the sides, but it does not press against the box. (Double-layer bag)

figures.name: DIMOO in Space Crane (Secret)
figures.feel: Easy Identify Box. All six directions only produce silica packet sounds. The middle-lower area on all four sides feels extremely full, with only a very slight and barely noticeable pressure point. The pressure feeling is significantly different from other figures, making it a strong identification feature.

figures.name: DIMOO As Dash Parr
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. Vertical shake: The figure has a slight clunking feeling with very limited space, while the silica packet creates obvious tapping sounds. Front/back shake: Clear clunking around the lower-middle area, but movement space is limited. Left/right shake: The figure is almost fixed, but the accessory and silica packet create obvious clicking sounds. Squeeze test: The sides can slightly feel the figure, but it does not press against the box. Front, back, top, and bottom cannot be squeezed.

figures.name: DIMOO As Russell
figures.feel: No detailed shake data available yet.

figures.name: DIMOO As Remy
figures.feel: No detailed shake data available yet.

figures.name: DIMOO As Miguel Rivera
figures.feel: No detailed shake data available yet.

figures.name: DIMOO As WALL·E
figures.feel: No detailed shake data available yet.

series.name: HACI|Take Me Home Series - Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Soft Pouting at 157.2g is heaviest. No Thoughts at 130.9g is lightest with ~1.5 fingers front/back space. Chomping Away is completely locked side-to-side, making it a dead box.

figures.name: Soft Pouting
figures.feel: Heaviest regular figure. Vertical shake: overall box tapping with light rubbing around the sides and clear card clicks. Front/back shake: light overall tapping with subtle rubbing. Left/right shake: gentle figure tapping with distinct card-clicking sounds.

figures.name: Spin in Circles
figures.feel: Vertical shake: light overall tapping with only a tiny amount of movement space. Front/back shake: light impacts around the upper-middle area with a noticeable clunk. Left/right shake: upper-middle impacts with limited movement space. No squeeze feedback.

figures.name: Chomping Away
figures.feel: Vertical shake: overall tapping with rubbing around the box and noticeable silica packet rustling. Front/back shake: figure is almost completely locked, with only faint silica packet rustling and clicking. Left/right shake: figure does not move, while the silica packet creates obvious clicking sounds. No squeeze feedback.

figures.name: Clingy Whimper
figures.feel: Vertical shake: figure taps the box with a slight clunk. Front/back shake: light tapping with limited movement space and faint clicking sounds. Left/right shake: figure taps the box with very little movement. No squeeze feedback.

figures.name: Full of Attitude
figures.feel: Vertical shake: limited movement space with noticeable card-clicking sounds. Front/back shake: light impacts around the upper-middle area with a soft clunk. Left/right shake: clear upper-middle impacts with minimal movement space. No squeeze feedback.

figures.name: No Thoughts
figures.feel: Lightest regular figure. Vertical shake: about half a finger's worth of movement space with noticeable impacts from both ends. Front/back shake: strong impacts around the dog's nose area on the front artwork, with roughly one and a half fingers of movement space. Left/right shake: slight movement with light impacts around the center.

figures.name: Wagging Joy (Secret)
figures.feel: No detailed shake data available yet.

series.name: Peach Riot|Power Chords Series Figures
series.note: Poppy The Sea at 149.7g is heaviest. Gigi The Anthem and The Messenger both at 98.9g are lightest. Secret Gigi The Underworld at 120.69g has large movement space with overall box impacts.

figures.name: Poppy - The Sea
figures.feel: Heaviest regular figure. Vertical shake: strong top-and-bottom impacts with ID card and accessory sounds. Front/back shake: heavy impacts around the rear middle section. Left/right shake: light impacts on the right middle side, stronger impacts on the left middle side, with faint plastic shell sounds. (Small silica packet, accessory, plastic shell)

figures.name: Poppy - The Beauty
figures.feel: Front/back shake: strong impacts around the upper-left rear section. Vertical shake: top-and-bottom impacts with silica packet and bottom accessory contact. Left/right shake: light impacts around the middle-right area with silica packet sounds. (Large silica packet)

figures.name: Frankie - The Forger
figures.feel: Large vertical movement space with heavy top-and-bottom impacts, plus ID card and silica packet sounds near the bottom. Front/back shake: strong impacts around the front middle and lower sections, with lighter impacts at the lower rear. Left/right shake: large movement space, heavy impacts on the lower-right side and lighter impacts on the lower-left side. (Large silica packet)

figures.name: Gigi - The Underworld (Secret)
figures.feel: Front/back shake: strong silica packet impacts near the upper section. Left/right shake: large movement space with overall box impacts. Vertical shake: only the silica packet hits the box. Overall movement is distinctive and easy to separate from the regular figures. (Secret)

figures.name: Frankie - The Harvest
figures.feel: Front/back shake: strong impacts near the upper-middle rear section, light impacts on the lower-left front, with faint chain sounds. Left/right shake: impacts around the left middle section and lighter impacts on the upper-middle right. Vertical shake: bottom accessory and silica packet create noticeable impacts. (Small silica packet, accessory, plastic shell)

figures.name: Frankie - The Strategist
figures.feel: Left/right shake: impacts around the upper-middle right side. Front/back shake: strong impacts near the upper-middle rear section. Vertical shake: light figure movement with strong accessory impacts at the bottom. (Small silica packet, accessory)

figures.name: Poppy - The Guardian
figures.feel: Left/right shake: strong impacts around the upper-middle left side. Front/back shake: impacts on the upper-right rear section and lower-left accessory impacts. Vertical shake: figure barely moves, while the accessory and ID card hit the box. (Small silica packet, accessory)

figures.name: Frankie - The Thunder
figures.feel: Left/right shake: obvious impacts around the upper-right area. Front/back shake: impacts near the upper-left rear section. Vertical shake: accessory impacts at the bottom. (Small silica packet, accessory)

figures.name: Poppy - The Poet
figures.feel: Front/back shake: light impacts near the upper front, stronger impacts around the middle-left rear. Left/right shake: impacts around the lower-middle right side. Vertical shake: about one finger's worth of movement space, with obvious accessory and silica packet impacts at the bottom. (Large silica packet, accessory)

figures.name: Gigi - The Celebration
figures.feel: Large vertical movement space with heavy top-and-bottom impacts. Left/right shake: figure is almost locked, while the ID card taps against the sides. Front/back shake: strong impacts around the front middle and lower sections. (Small silica packet)

figures.name: Gigi - The Hunt
figures.feel: Front/back shake: strong impacts around the front middle-left area. Left/right shake: impacts around the left middle section. Vertical or inverted shake: accessories move freely, giving the figure a noticeably loose internal feel. (Multiple accessories, small silica packet)

figures.name: Gigi - The Anthem
figures.feel: Front/back shake: impacts near the upper rear and middle-left front. Vertical shake: figure barely moves; only the silica packet and ID card create impact sounds. Left/right shake: large movement space, with the figure, accessories, silica packet, and ID card all moving together. (Large silica packet, accessory)

figures.name: Gigi - The Messenger
figures.feel: Left/right shake: obvious accessory impacts around the lower-right area. Front/back shake: large movement space with strong impacts near the upper rear. Vertical shake: large movement space with heavy top-and-bottom impacts. (Large silica packet, accessory)

series.name: THE MONSTERS|Hair Salon Series Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Velvet Noon at 210.5g is heaviest with fully packed dead-box feel. Blue Prelude at 190g is lightest. Coastal Vibes has distinctive metal keyring tapping. Overall feel is similar across series - differentiate by weight.

figures.name: Velvet Noon
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. One of the heaviest figures, with long, thick hair that fills the box. Extremely limited movement from every direction, making it feel like a fully packed dead box.

figures.name: After Rain
figures.feel: Matches the standard pattern. Large front/back movement with noticeable impacts, minimal vertical movement, and very little side-to-side space.

figures.name: Born Rebel
figures.feel: Follows the standard shake pattern. Large front/back movement with strong impacts, slight vertical movement, and a tightly packed left/right feel.

figures.name: Hazy Noisy (Secret)
figures.feel: Vertical shake: light overall box tapping with noticeable silica packet rustling. Front/back shake: slight figure tapping with very limited movement space and audible silica packet impacts. Left/right shake: light figure tapping with faint card-clicking sounds. No squeeze feedback from any side. Overall feels very full and densely packed.

figures.name: Coastal Vibes
figures.feel: Nearly identical to the standard shake pattern, but with one key difference: you can clearly feel the metal keyring tapping during movement. Front/back has large movement space, slight vertical play, and almost no side-to-side movement.

figures.name: Warm Oat
figures.feel: Shares the same shake profile as Blue Prelude. Large front/back movement with obvious impacts, slight vertical movement, and an almost completely packed feel from left to right.

figures.name: Blue Prelude
figures.feel: Lightest in the series. The overall feel is very similar to most of the series. Front/back shake has a large movement space with noticeable impacts. Vertical shake has a small amount of movement. Left/right feels very full with almost no movement.

series.name: THE MONSTERS|Hair Salon Series Figures
series.note: Secret Twinning Looks at 136.8g is heaviest with completely locked dual base. Braided Pigtails at 120.4g is lightest and loosest. Salon Manager at 132.6g is heaviest regular dead-box.

figures.name: Twinning Looks (Secret)
figures.feel: Heaviest in the series. Absolutely no movement space. Feels significantly heavier than every regular figure. The dual-character base creates a deep, solid thud when moved. The entire box feels completely locked, making it one of the easiest secrets to identify.

figures.name: Salon Manager
figures.feel: Heavier regular figure. Virtually no movement space. No impacts or collisions during shaking. Completely locked side-to-side, with a noticeably heavy and dense feel in hand.

figures.name: Beauty Specialist
figures.feel: Extremely limited movement vertically with no impact sensation. Only slight contact around the center of the box. Feels full, thick, and solid with no hollow areas.

figures.name: Master Hairstylist
figures.feel: Almost no movement space at all. Only faint card sounds can be heard. Internal packing is dense and rigid, representing the classic fully packed blind-box feel.

figures.name: Salon Apprentice
figures.feel: Very little vertical movement with light bottom rubbing. Soft fixed-point tapping around the lower-middle area. Completely locked side-to-side, with a dense and muted feel.

figures.name: Flip Ends
figures.feel: Small amount of movement space vertically with light bottom contact. A fixed rubbing point can be detected around the center of the box. Side-to-side feels densely packed and solid.

figures.name: Outward Bob
figures.feel: About half a finger's worth of movement space vertically. Card sounds are crisp and clear. Even rubbing can be felt front-to-back and around the upper-middle area. Side-to-side movement is nearly locked, with solid internal packing.

figures.name: Get a Perm
figures.feel: Extremely subtle movement vertically. Only faint card rustling can be heard. Light box contact around the upper-middle area, with an overall muted sound profile.

figures.name: Blunt Bangs
figures.feel: Only slight vertical movement with no obvious impacts. The figure sits close to the box walls, creating light rubbing on both sides. Balanced and stable overall feel.

figures.name: High Ponytail
figures.feel: Small amount of vertical movement with light rubbing against the bottom wall. Plastic component friction can be heard around the center when shaken front-to-back. Side-to-side movement is almost completely locked, giving it a dense, compact feel.

figures.name: Loose Waves
figures.feel: Very little vertical movement, with only faint card sounds. No fixed impact point front-to-back, just light rubbing along both sides of the box.

figures.name: Wild Blowout
figures.feel: About half a finger's worth of vertical movement space with moderate movement. The hair dryer accessory creates a distinctive rubbing sound. Only slight movement side-to-side.

figures.name: Braided Pigtails
figures.feel: Lightest regular figure. Generous movement space inside the box. Crisp bottom impacts when shaken vertically. Light rubbing can be felt from all six sides. Overall feel is loose, with very noticeable silica packet grain sounds.

series.name: Kubo|Love, Still Series Figures
series.note: Dreams of You at 149.5g is heaviest. April Showers at 95.1g is lightest. Secret Folded Wishes at 113.5g has distinctive large loose accessory movement.

figures.name: Dreams of You
figures.feel: The heaviest figure in the series. Front/back shake reveals slight movement with light impacts around the center. Left/right shake produces strong impacts on both middle sides. Vertical shake creates heavy bottom impacts. (Small accessory, small silica packet)

figures.name: Build Our Home
figures.feel: Left/right shake creates strong impacts around the middle left side. Front/back shake has large movement space, with heavy impacts on the front middle section and lighter impacts near the lower rear section. Vertical shake produces strong bottom impacts accompanied by silica packet and ID card sounds. (Medium silica packet)

figures.name: Folded Wishes (Secret)
figures.feel: Feels noticeably heavy. Slight movement vertically and front-to-back, with a large accessory moving freely inside. Left/right movement is limited due to the oversized accessory occupying most of the space. The accessory movement sound is the key identifier, as it is not secured in place. (Large accessory)

figures.name: Coming with Flowers
figures.feel: Front/back shake produces slight movement with silica packet sounds. Vertical shake causes the accessory, ID card, and silica packet to hit the bottom of the box. Left/right shake reveals loose accessory impacts. (Medium silica packet, loose accessory)

figures.name: Before the Curtain Falls
figures.feel: Front/back shake causes impacts around the upper-middle front section. Vertical shake has large movement space with heavy bottom impacts. Left/right shake creates strong impacts near the upper left side, accompanied by loud silica packet sounds. (Large accessory, large silica packet)

figures.name: Early Summer
figures.feel: Front/back shake has large impacts around the front middle and lower sections, with strong silica packet sounds. Left/right shake creates heavy impacts around the middle left side. Vertical shake has about two fingers' worth of movement space, with obvious accessory impacts at the bottom and loud silica packet noise. (Small accessory, large silica packet)

figures.name: Love Is Blind
figures.feel: Front/back shake creates strong impacts around the upper-middle rear section with prominent silica packet sounds. Vertical shake: the figure barely moves, while the ID card taps against the box along with loud silica packet noise. Left/right shake shows light, evenly distributed movement. (Small accessory, large silica packet)

figures.name: Ashes of a Secret
figures.feel: When held firmly during front/back shaking, only silica packet sounds remain. A noticeable pressure point can be felt near the lower-left front section. Left/right shake creates light impacts around the middle left side with silica packet sounds. Vertical shake causes accessory impacts at the bottom with loud silica packet noise. (Large accessory, large silica packet)

figures.name: Catch the Bloom
figures.feel: The figure is packed very tightly and barely moves from any direction. The most noticeable clue is the loud silica packet movement. Light ID card tapping can be heard when shaken vertically or side-to-side. (Large accessory, medium silica packet)

figures.name: First Love
figures.feel: Front/back shake creates light impacts near the lower rear section. Left/right shake produces stronger impacts near the lower left side. Vertical shake has large movement space, with heavy bottom impacts accompanied by ID card and silica packet sounds. (Small accessory, small silica packet)

figures.name: To You
figures.feel: Front/back shake causes tapping around the upper rear section, accompanied by silica packet sounds. Left/right shake produces impacts around the upper-middle left side. Vertical shake results in moderate bottom impacts with strong silica packet noise. (Large silica packet)

figures.name: Unspoken Heartbeat
figures.feel: Left/right shake produces strong impacts near the lower left side. Front/back shake creates strong impacts around the front middle-left area. Vertical shake has about two fingers' worth of movement space, with heavy bottom impacts and noticeable silica packet sounds. (Small accessory, small silica packet)

figures.name: April Showers
figures.feel: The lightest figure in the series. Vertical shake feels very full, with only the ID card tapping the box. Front/back shake produces only silica packet sounds. Left/right shake reveals slight tapping near the lower sides of the box. (Large accessory, small silica packet)

series.name: Baby Molly|Buggy Roam Series Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Strolling Ladybug at 118.3g is heaviest and completely locked. Fluttering Butterfly at 109.1g is lightest and loosest. Secret Wandering Dragonfly at 110.5g has unique wing-friction sounds.

figures.name: Strolling Ladybug
figures.feel: Heaviest regular figure. Vertical shake: No extra movement space at all. Feels fully packed when squeezed, with no bottom impacts. Front/back shake: Completely muted. No tapping or rubbing sounds, and even the silica packet is barely noticeable. Left/right shake: Completely locked. The densest and most tightly packed regular figure in the series, making it very easy to identify.

figures.name: Busy-Busy Ant
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Very little movement. Almost no bottom impact, with only faint card sounds. Front/back shake: Light fixed-point tapping around the lower-middle area. Soft and controlled, never producing heavy collisions. Left/right shake: Completely immobile. Internal packing feels dense and secure, with no excess space.

figures.name: Lively Bee
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Only a small amount of movement space. Slight bottom impact with a soft card-tapping sound, but no heavy collisions. Front/back shake: Continuous light rubbing around the center of the box. Plush friction sounds are noticeable, with no fixed-point impacts. Left/right shake: Almost completely locked in place. Silica packet sounds are softened by the plush material, giving it a compact and tightly packed feel.

figures.name: Wandering Dragonfly (Secret)
figures.feel: Vertical shake: Moderate movement, sitting between Lively Bee and Fluttering Butterfly. No heavy bottom impacts. Front/back shake: Distinctive light wing-accessory friction sounds that differ from the plush rubbing heard in the regular figures. Left/right shake: Light impacts around the center of the box. Overall sound profile is softer, and the packed feeling is less dense than Strolling Ladybug or Busy-Busy Ant.

figures.name: Fluttering Butterfly
figures.feel: Lightest figure in the series. Vertical shake: About half a finger's worth of movement space. Noticeably looser movement with a crisp card-clicking sound. Front/back shake: Light rubbing against the box, with subtle wing-friction sounds along the sides. Left/right shake: Slight movement with an overall looser feel, standing out clearly from the tighter-packed regular figures.

series.name: Mist-Walker Vinyl Plush Pendant Series
series.note: The Unfallen Wing at 173.7g is heaviest. The Primordial Grace at 159.6g is lightest. Secret figure The Tempered Aegis at 165.2g weighs same as The Wingless Follower - differentiate by feel.

figures.name: The Unfallen Wing
figures.feel: The heaviest figure in the series. Front/back shake has large movement space with strong box impacts. Left/right shake has slight movement accompanied by silica packet sounds. Vertical shake: the figure itself barely moves; only the ID card taps against the box along with silica packet noise.

figures.name: The Gap-Glimmer Wanderer
figures.feel: Large movement space when shaken front/back or left/right. Vertical movement is much more restricted. Silica packet can be heard moving inside.

figures.name: The Soul Corroder
figures.feel: Front/back shake feels very full with only faint silica packet sounds. Vertical shake is similarly packed, with only the silica packet hitting the box. Left/right shake has limited movement space, accompanied by both silica packet and ID card sounds.

figures.name: The Tempered Aegis (Secret)
figures.feel: Front/back shake: large movement space with heavy impacts around the upper-middle rear section. Left/right shake: evenly distributed movement with light tapping around the upper-middle area. Vertical shake: noticeable top-and-bottom impacts, mainly caused by the silica packet.

figures.name: The Wingless Follower
figures.feel: Front/back shake feels full with only light silica packet sounds. Vertical shake produces only silica packet impacts. Left/right shake has slightly more movement space than The Soul Corroder, along with silica packet and ID card noises.

figures.name: The Backlit Messenger
figures.feel: All six sides show noticeable movement. Front/back and vertical movement feel evenly distributed, while left/right shake has the largest movement space. Silica packet sounds are present throughout.

figures.name: The Primordial Grace
figures.feel: The lightest figure in the series. Vertical shake: light overall box tapping with distinct clicking sounds. Front/back shake: obvious box impacts with noticeable clunking. Left/right shake: strong overall impacts with a pronounced clunking feel. No squeeze feedback can be detected from any side.

series.name: inosoul|Rainy Reveries Series Figures
series.note: Sofa so Good at 161.73g is heaviest regular. Secret Flow of Time at 148.2g has 2 silica packs, very full front/back, upper area hits left/right.

figures.name: Sofa so Good
figures.feel: Almost no movement from any direction. Feels very full and dense. Slight pressure against the box when shaken front-to-back.

figures.name: I Meow You
figures.feel: Front/back shake: tapping around the upper-middle area. Left/right shake: similar upper-middle tapping. Vertical shake: heavy, dull impacts from the bottom.

figures.name: A Single Tear
figures.feel: Front/back shake: the left ear of the figure taps against the box. Left/right shake: almost completely immobile. Vertical shake: large amount of movement space with strong bottom impacts.

figures.name: The Dream We Had
figures.feel: Front/back shake: overall box tapping. Left/right shake: accessory tapping is noticeable. Vertical shake: limited movement space with silica packet movement sounds.

figures.name: Roaming on the Edge
figures.feel: Almost no movement from any direction. Feels very full and tightly packed inside the box.

figures.name: The Star Weaver
figures.feel: Front/back shake: tapping around the lower-middle area. Left/right shake: tapping around the upper-middle area. Vertical shake: only the silica packet can be heard moving.

figures.name: The Unhealed Wound
figures.feel: Front/back shake: tapping around the center. Left/right shake: mostly immobile, with slight pressure against the box in the middle area. Vertical shake: strong bottom impacts.

figures.name: A Little Luck
figures.feel: Front/back/left/right shake: tapping around the upper-middle area. Vertical shake: strong bottom impacts.

figures.name: Hide in the Clouds
figures.feel: Front/back/left/right shake: noticeable overall box tapping. Vertical shake: large amount of movement space.

figures.name: The Unsent Letter
figures.feel: Front/back shake: tapping around the lower-middle area. Left/right shake: center-area tapping with pressure against the right side of the box. Vertical shake: limited movement space.

figures.name: Serein and Wild Daisies
figures.feel: Front/back shake: strong impact around the figure's face (cover-facing side). Left/right shake: very obvious lower-section impacts with large movement space. Vertical shake: strong bottom impacts.

figures.name: Until Spring Comes
figures.feel: Large movement space in every direction, with obvious overall box tapping.

figures.name: The Flow of Time (Secret)
figures.feel: Vertical shake: obvious silica packet sound (2 packs). Front/back: feels very full, immobile, with silica packet sounds. Left/right: upper area hits the box.

series.name: I'm Zsiga Series-Vinyl Plush Pendant
series.note: Secret Fearless at 178.2g is heaviest in series! Extremely heavy, almost no movement, only faint silica packet rubbing. Shy at 162.07g is lightest.

figures.name: Fearless (Secret)
figures.feel: Extremely heavy in hand. Almost no movement from any direction, with only the faintest silica packet rubbing sound. One side of the box may have a slight bulge, and shaking it produces a unique, subtle friction sound. Look for the box that feels exceptionally heavy and tightly packed.

figures.name: Free-spirited
figures.feel: Feels noticeably heavy and densely packed. Most directions are completely locked with almost no movement, except for a tiny amount of play vertically. No hard-object collision sounds at all. Feels solid, dense, and substantial when squeezed.

figures.name: Strong-willed
figures.feel: A clear tapping sound can be heard from the upper front area when shaken. The sound is crisp rather than dull or muffled. Very little background noise, making it one of the easier figures to identify during blind-box hunting.

figures.name: Sincere
figures.feel: Very little movement overall. Only a faint bumping sensation when shaken front-to-back, with a deep, muted sound.

figures.name: Veiled
figures.feel: Feels slightly softer in hand. Has about half a finger's worth of vertical movement space. The box surface feels smooth, with no obvious hard protrusions or foreign-object sensation.

figures.name: Frank
figures.feel: Consistent shake pattern. The tapping force feels evenly distributed in all directions, while the silica packet sound remains very faint.

figures.name: Shy
figures.feel: Noticeably lighter than the others. Has significant vertical movement, while the other directions feel relatively fixed. No box-tapping sound when shaken—only the distinctive rustling sound of the silica packet rubbing against the box walls.

series.name: 1001 Moons|Wind's Intention Series Figures
series.note: Little Flicker at 127.74g is heaviest regular. Secret Lily of the Valley at 113.5g feels heavy and dense, almost no movement, multiple accessories, no obvious pressure points.

figures.name: Little Flicker
figures.feel: Vertical shake: limited movement space, but accessory movement can be heard clearly. Front/back shake: small movement space with noticeable clunking. Left/right shake: limited movement space with clear clicking sounds. When squeezing front/back, the lower-middle part of the figure can faintly be felt, though it does not press against the box. Slight bag sounds from the sides; none from top/bottom.

figures.name: Falling Camellia
figures.feel: Vertical shake: light figure tapping with a clunking feel and clear card-clicking sounds. Front/back shake: figure barely moves, but the card clicking against the box is very obvious. Left/right shake: figure tapping with a clunking feel and soft rustling sounds. Very faint bag sounds can be detected when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Sway in the Wind (Secret)
figures.feel: Feels noticeably heavy and well-packed in hand. Almost no movement when shaken from any direction. Contains multiple accessories, contributing to the dense overall feel. No obvious pressure points. Key clue: Look for a box that feels heavy, dense, and nearly motionless.

figures.name: Wings of Autumn
figures.feel: Vertical shake: figure taps the box with a noticeable clunk, though movement space is limited. Left/right shake: similar limited movement space with clunking sounds. Front/back shake: light tapping with moderate space, accompanied by rattling and clunking sounds. Slight bag sounds when squeezing front/back/left/right; none from top/bottom.

figures.name: As the Smoke Recedes
figures.feel: Vertical shake: almost no movement. Feels very full but surprisingly light in hand. Front/back shake: nearly immobile, maintaining a full feeling with only faint silica grain movement. Left/right shake: figure does not move at all; only slight silica packet rubbing can be heard. Very faint bag sounds can be felt when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Refractions of Moonlight
figures.feel: Vertical shake: completely immobile. Front/back shake: completely immobile, with only slight silica packet rubbing sounds. Left/right shake: figure does not move at all, but the card produces faint clicking sounds. Very light bag sounds can be felt when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Scent of the Wind
figures.feel: Vertical shake: the figure lightly taps the box, with a noticeable card-clicking sound. Front/back shake: light figure tapping. Left/right shake: figure taps the box, accompanied by silica packet collision sounds. Slight bag crinkle can be felt from front/back/left/right squeezing, but not from top/bottom.

figures.name: Echoes of Summer
figures.feel: Vertical shake: figure taps the box, accompanied by silica packet rustling. Front/back shake: almost no movement, only a tiny bit of space with silica grain rattling. Left/right shake: very light figure tapping, slight bag sounds, and silica packet rattling. Strong bag sounds when squeezing front/back; nothing noticeable from left/right/top/bottom.

figures.name: Across Mountains and Seas
figures.feel: Vertical shake: very small amount of movement space with light box tapping. Front/back shake: similarly small movement space and tapping. Left/right shake: tiny amount of movement with a very faint clunk. Bag can be clearly felt when squeezing front/back/left/right; slight bag sounds from top/bottom.

figures.name: Dancing in the Rain
figures.feel: Vertical shake: figure barely taps the box, but the accessory creates a very noticeable clunk and rubs against one side of the box. Front/back shake: very light figure tapping with little sound, while the accessory creates faint clunking. Left/right shake: obvious overall clunking and clicking sounds. Slight bag sounds when squeezing front/back; none from top/bottom/left/right.

series.name: Hacipupu|Enchanted Realm Tales Series MINI Action Figure
series.note: Carrot Guardian at 147.3g is heaviest regular. Secret Time Treehouse at 140.2g feels very heavy and packed solid, barely moves when shaken.

figures.name: Carrot Guardian
figures.feel: Vertical shake has light box tapping with a pretty noticeable clunk. Front/back shake gives light tapping, especially stronger near the bottom, along with bag sounds. Left/right shake has light overall tapping, with more obvious movement around the lower-middle area. Very faint bag sounds when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Whimsical Inventor
figures.feel: Vertical shake gives light box tapping with a noticeable clunk plus accessory bag sounds. Front/back shake: figure barely moves, but the silica packet clicking against the box is very obvious. Left/right shake: almost no movement, with strong silica packet clicking. Slight bag sounds can be felt when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Time Treehouse (Secret)
figures.feel: Feels very heavy and packed solid in hand. Almost no empty space top-to-bottom, with a stuffed/full feeling on all sides. Barely moves when shaken. Pressing lightly around the middle has noticeable resistance. Main clue: look for the one that feels heavy, dense, and puffed full.

figures.name: Wonderland Guide
figures.feel: Vertical shake: figure itself barely moves, but the silica packet clicking is very obvious. Front/back shake: almost no movement, with distinct silica grain collision sounds. Left/right shake is similar — barely moves, but strong silica packet rattling. Bag sounds are very obvious when squeezing front/back/left/right, with only slight sounds from top/bottom.

figures.name: Mood Monster
figures.feel: Vertical shake causes the figure to rub and tap against the box with obvious bag sounds. Front/back shake has very light tapping and just a tiny amount of movement space. Left/right shake also gives light tapping with plastic bag scraping sounds. Bag noise is obvious when squeezing all four sides; nothing noticeable from top/bottom.

figures.name: Cloud Dream Catcher
figures.feel: Vertical shake has obvious overall box movement with a noticeable clunk. Front/back shake is even louder and more obvious. Left/right shake has moderate movement space with clear bag sounds. No noticeable squeeze feedback from front/back/top/bottom, but slight bag sounds from the sides.

figures.name: Magical Seer
figures.feel: Vertical shake has light figure tapping, but accessory clicking sounds are very obvious, along with a loose rattling sound. Front/back shake produces noticeable clunking from the figure. Left/right shake has obvious clunking plus accessory clicks. No squeeze feedback on any side.

figures.name: Floral Messenger
figures.feel: Vertical shake has only a small amount of box space with a very faint silica packet grain sound and slight knocking. Front/back shake: figure barely moves, tiny bit of space, plus soft silica packet rattling. Left/right shake: almost no figure movement, but the card hitting the box makes a clear clicking sound. Bag crinkle can be felt from front/back/left/right squeezing, but not from top/bottom.

figures.name: Starry Night Keeper
figures.feel: Vertical shake gives very light overall tapping with just a tiny bit of movement space. Front/back shake has an extremely slight wobble with obvious bag sounds. Left/right shake has a tiny amount of tapping space plus clear card clicking sounds. Very faint bag sounds can be felt when squeezing all six sides.

figures.name: Elf Prince
figures.feel: Vertical shake has some clunking but not much free space overall; accessory clicking is very obvious. Front/back shake produces figure clunks with bag scraping sounds. Left/right shake has a loose rattling sound, especially around the upper-middle area. Slight bag sounds when squeezing front/back; nothing noticeable from top/bottom/left/right.

series.name: POPMART|Dear Birds Series Plush Pendant Blind Box
series.note: SP A Dawn Duet at 131.8g is heaviest regular. Secret More Than Words at 118.8g is medium weight, full top/bottom, pointed beak creates hit point on one side.

figures.name: Skullpanda-A Dawn Duet
figures.feel: Top/bottom: immobile. Left/right: slight shake. Front/back: small space, upper-middle area has large area hitting back and forth.

figures.name: Hirono-My Deepest Secret
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 1 finger space, bottom hits. Left/right: almost immobile. Front/back: almost immobile.

figures.name: Crybaby-Shall We Dance
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 1.5 finger space, bottom hits. Left/right: relatively large space, card side second row and below hits back and forth. Front/back: Molly's left braid on cover hits.

figures.name: Molly-My Sweet Trouble
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 0.5 finger space. Left/right: relatively large space, card side second row hits back and forth. Front/back: small space, only the ring hits back and forth.

figures.name: Labubu-Dive into Love
figures.feel: Top/bottom: slight shake. Left/right: small space, card side middle-left hits. Front/back: relatively large space, Molly's bangs on cover has subtle hit.

figures.name: Dimoo-Whispers of Love
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 0.5-1 finger space. Left/right: immobile. Front/back: small space, 'IR' in 'BIRD' text on cover hits.

figures.name: Twinkle Twinkle-Waiting in Snow
figures.feel: Top/bottom: immobile. Left/right: slight shake, upside down shake hits symmetrically at HACI position. Front/back: immobile.

figures.name: Hacipupu-Make Me Blush
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 2 finger space, hits top/bottom. Left/right: smaller space than front/back, card side upper-middle hits. Front/back: large space, yellow eyebrow on left side of cover hits.

figures.name: Hirono-More Than Words (Secret)
figures.feel: Top/bottom feel fully packed. Front/back/left/right can move slightly when shaken. Overall feels relatively full. Secret has pointed beak creating one specific hit point - around middle of front side.

series.name: Crybaby|Cry Me An Ocean Series - VinylPlush Pendant Blind Box
series.note: Plush pendant version. The Pufferfish at 99.6g is heaviest regular, Secret Sea Otter at 95.9g is medium-light.

figures.name: The Pufferfish
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 1 finger space, bottom hits. Left/right: not much space, card side Manta Ray and opposite hidden card hit back and forth. Front/back: similar to left/right, middle of Chinese text on back hits.

figures.name: The Manta Ray
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 2+ finger space, hits top/bottom. Left/right: immobile, card hits back and forth. Front/back: immobile, upside down shake hits above barcode on back (probably desiccant). PS: This box is placed diagonally.

figures.name: The Sea Turtle
figures.feel: Top/bottom: almost immobile, card rattles around. Left/right: slight shake, card side Sea Turtle face hits. Front/back: more space than left/right, below letter O on cover hits.

figures.name: The Shark
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 2+ finger space, bottom hits. Left/right: almost immobile, card hits back and forth. Front/back: slight shake, dot-like hit above Crybaby's right eye on cover.

figures.name: The Sea Bunny
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 1 finger space, bottom hits. Left/right: almost immobile, card rattles around. Front/back: slight shake, dot-like hit at pufferfish tear on cover.

figures.name: The Anglerfish
figures.feel: Top/bottom: 0.5 finger space. Left/right: relatively large space, hits between Sea Bunny and Turtle on card side. Front/back: slight shake, slight hit at pufferfish top on cover and same spot on back.

figures.name: The Sea Otter (Secret)
figures.feel: No space when shaking up/down (try shaking hard - still no space, some regular figures need hard shaking too). Space on all four sides (front/back/left/right), but only one side hits box hard at upper-middle position. Desiccant 4.62g.

series.name: Crybaby|Cry Me an Ocean Series Figures
series.note: Secrets have magnetic accessories on the side! Heavy ~176g is small secret Whale Shark, light ~136g is super secret Sea Otter (lightest in series). Narwhal 182.1g is heaviest regular, shells are interchangeable!

figures.name: The Narwhal
figures.feel: Heavy box, slight bulge all around but not poking. Large gap top/bottom with clear hitting feel. Shells are interchangeable, very playable!

figures.name: The Whale Shark(Secret)
figures.feel: Visible box! Slight shake top/bottom, slight bulge at upper-middle front/back. Magnetic accessory on side - only secrets have magnetic accessories!

figures.name: The Walrus
figures.feel: Full and tight box, all three sides full, no shake top/bottom. Multiple slight bulges but not obvious. (Desiccant ~10g)

figures.name: The Whale
figures.feel: Bulging all around front/back/left/right, strong hitting feel top/bottom

figures.name: The Anglerfish
figures.feel: Three-sided hitting feel, obvious bulge on left/right sides

figures.name: The Blob Fish
figures.feel: Super full box, right-center front/back bulging prominently. Clear hitting top/bottom, fish shell is larger

figures.name: The Sea Turtle
figures.feel: Box fairly full, only slight shake. Desiccant hitting obvious, slight bulge with no sharp points

figures.name: The Octopus
figures.feel: Three-sided hitting feel obvious, no protruding points overall

figures.name: The Jellyfish
figures.feel: Interior slightly spacious, slight hitting on all three sides

figures.name: The Shark
figures.feel: Bulge at middle left/right and lower front/back, obvious hitting feel top/bottom

figures.name: The Manta Ray
figures.feel: Box not super full but completely immobile. Point at lower-left of card left/right, slight bulge at middle front/back, point not prominent

figures.name: The Pufferfish
figures.feel: Overall empty and not full, obvious hitting feel on all three sides

figures.name: The Sea Bunny
figures.feel: Overall full, bulge at exact center front/back, obvious sharp point at left-center left/right, only 0.5cm gap top/bottom

figures.name: The Sea Otter(Super Secret)
figures.feel: Visible box! Lightest in series, space top/bottom, all four sides fairly full. Magnetic accessory on side!

series.name: aespa|Fluffy Club Series Vinyl Plush Doll Pendant
series.note: Hidden tip: Card has plastic film (like LABUBU BIE secret Id). Regular cards hit hand, hidden cards don't. Regular cards make loud box sound, hidden cards make muffled sound. Shake patiently, cards get stuck easily. Jelly Giselle at 142-144g is the heaviest!

figures.name: Jelly GELBULNYANGI (Giselle Secret)
figures.feel: Heaviest hidden! Distinctly heavy, instantly distinguishable. Box doesn't move when shaken, pinching reveals full plush feeling, can even feel internal shape outline. No hollow sounds. Pick the obviously heavy ones that don't shake - can't go wrong!

figures.name: Jelly KARANGI (Karina Secret)
figures.feel: Second heaviest hidden! Noticeably heavy, heavier than Ningning. Can't shake at all, all six sides full, no extra space when pinching. Very weak desiccant sound. Pick heaviest boxes after excluding Giselle.

figures.name: Jelly RWE (Ningning Secret)
figures.feel: Ningning fans must see! Medium-heavy weight, noticeable but not overwhelming. Six sides barely move, only slight desiccant friction sound, no accessory clicking. Pinching reveals slight bulge on sides. Pick medium-heavy with full feel.

figures.name: Jelly MUNGTAENGI (Winter Secret)
figures.feel: Lightest hidden of the four, close to some regular weights - focus on feel! Light but solid, 1cm space top/bottom when shaking, locked front/back/left/right. Pinching reveals slight resistance at card middle. Plush feels finer than regular. Don't confuse with light regulars!

figures.name: Fluffy KARANGI
figures.feel: Card hits box top/bottom, hits middle left/right, almost no space front/back

figures.name: Fluffy RWE
figures.feel: Slight desiccant sound top/bottom, slight hitting upper-middle left/right and front/back

figures.name: Fluffy MUNGTAENGI
figures.feel: Loud hitting sound top/bottom, hits middle left/right, slight hitting upper-middle front/back

figures.name: Fluffy GELBULNYANGI
figures.feel: Card slightly hits box top/bottom, loud hitting upper-middle left/right, slight hitting upper-middle front/back

series.name: POLAR|Monster Village Series Figures
series.note: Secret Trickkey at 110.47g is one of the lightest. Feels full all around but desiccant granule sound is obvious.

figures.name: Trickkey(Secret)
figures.feel: Secret! Shake up/down: main body lightly scratches/shakes box, feels full all around, but desiccant granule sound is obvious. Shake front/back: overall hitting, not much space, desiccant granule sound. Shake left/right: main body lightly hits, but desiccant and card clicking sound obvious.

figures.name: Snuggo
figures.feel: Shake up/down: 1.5 finger space, heavy up/down hitting with ID card sound. Hold front/back: internal plastic bottle shakes, pressing front middle/bottom has resistance. Shake left/right: full, only ID card and desiccant sound. (Small desiccant, 2 cards)

figures.name: Dingo
figures.feel: Shake up/down: bottom accessory hits box heavily with ID card and desiccant sound. Shake left/right: left middle hits heavily. Shake front/back: front left side hits. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Villio
figures.feel: Shake up/down: heavy up/down hitting with accessory hitting. Shake front/back: front upper-middle hits heavily, back middle hits lightly with loud desiccant sound. Shake left/right: right upper-middle hits. (Medium desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Mingoo
figures.feel: Shake front/back: large space, back upper hits heavily, front upper hits lightly. Shake left/right: left upper hits heavily. Shake up/down: main body immobile, only 2-card hitting sound. (Small desiccant, 2 cards)

figures.name: Gambit
figures.feel: Shake left/right: both sides hit at bottom lightly with loud desiccant sound. Shake front/back: back middle hits lightly. Shake up/down: large shaking space, bottom hits heavily. (Medium desiccant, 2 cards, 2 accessories)

figures.name: Leybo
figures.feel: Shake left/right: small space, right middle hits. Shake front/back: slight desiccant sound, pressing front middle POLAR horn area has slight resistance. Shake up/down: 1 finger space with desiccant sound. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, 2 accessories)

figures.name: Cooper
figures.feel: Shake up/down: up/down hitting with obvious 2-card hitting. Shake left/right: right upper hits lightly, loud 2-card shaking. Shake front/back: large space, both front/back upper-middle hit heavily. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Nmenber
figures.feel: Shake left/right: right upper-middle hits. Shake up/down: large space, bottom hits heavily. Shake front/back: front middle hits, back upper-left hits. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Erios
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body immobile, only desiccant and 2-card hitting sound. Shake left/right: left middle hits with 2-card sound. Shake front/back: front lower-middle hits. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, plastic protective case)

figures.name: Leeboo
figures.feel: Shake front/back: back left-middle hits, front right-upper-middle hits. Shake up/down: feels loose, accessory and main body bottom hit. Shake left/right: left middle hits with desiccant sound, right middle/bottom hits with ID card and desiccant sound. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Qeyes
figures.feel: Shake up/down: 1 finger space, accessory bottom hits heavily with slight desiccant sound. Shake front/back: back middle hits lightly. Shake left/right: right upper-left hits lightly. (Small desiccant, 2 cards, has accessory)

figures.name: Hob&Pip
figures.feel: Shake up/down: loud desiccant sound, internal card hits heavily. Shake front/back: front middle hits lightly with loud desiccant sound. Shake left/right: right left-middle hits lightly with desiccant and card sound. (Medium desiccant, 3 cards)

series.name: Nyota|Where Moments Meet Series Figures
series.note: Secret is the heaviest at 168.1g (others are around 150g or below). Cannot shake up/down. Clear bulge in the middle (eye area on cover).

figures.name: Spring Outing(Secret)
figures.feel: Secret! Heaviest at 168.1g. Cannot shake up/down. Clear bulge in the middle (eye area on cover).

figures.name: Hi Lumi
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body completely immobile, but clear clicking sound from card hitting box. Shake front/back: tiny space, clear clicking from keyring. Shake left/right: accessory keyring scratches box with clicking, main body lightly touches. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can clearly feel the doll. Cannot feel left/right or up/down.

figures.name: 3PM
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body completely immobile, but desiccant pack clearly scratches/hits box. Shake front/back: main body immobile, desiccant pack hits with granule and clicking sound. Shake left/right: main body immobile, desiccant makes rustling sound. Pinch left/right: clear bag sound. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can clearly feel doll. Pinch up/down: slight bag sound.

figures.name: Goodnight Kitty
figures.feel: Shake up/down: overall bag sound, accessory keyring clearly clicks against box. Shake front/back: overall slight hitting, not much space. Shake left/right: main body barely moves, but keyring clicking is clear. Pinch left/right: bag sound. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can feel doll. Cannot feel up/down.

figures.name: Star Catcher
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body immobile, but keyring clicking and scratching sounds clear. Shake front/back: main body immobile, only keyring hitting. Shake left/right: overall slight hitting with light banging. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can feel doll. Pinch left/right: bag sound. Cannot feel up/down.

figures.name: Hopscotch
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body completely immobile, only desiccant granule sound and accessory clicking. Shake front/back: accessory clicks against box, main body immobile.
