Shake left/right: main body immobile, accessory clicking clear. Pinch left/right: clear bag sound. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can feel doll. Cannot feel up/down.

figures.name: Let's Draw
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body barely moves, but keyring clicking clear. Shake front/back: main body lightly hits with banging sound. Shake left/right: main body barely moves, desiccant lightly hits. Pinch left/right: bag sound. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can feel doll. Cannot feel up/down.

figures.name: Sunny Nap
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body has tiny space, scratches and hits box, accessory clicking clear. Shake front/back: main body has tiny space, accessory and desiccant hit clearly. Shake left/right: main body completely immobile, keyring clicking clear. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can feel doll. Pinch left/right: clear bag sound. Cannot feel up/down.

figures.name: Happy Harvest
figures.feel: Shake up/down: main body scratches/hits box, not much space, keyring clicking. Shake front/back: main body has tiny space, barely moves, keyring and desiccant clicking. Shake left/right: main body barely moves, desiccant scratches/hits. Pinch front/back upper-middle: can clearly feel doll's face. Pinch left/right: slight bag sound. Cannot feel up/down.

series.name: SKULLPANDA|Petals in Four Acts Series Figures

figures.name: Chronos' Gardener
figures.feel: Secret! Listen for the rotating sound (very faint). Full top/bottom with almost no space. Larger space at lower front/back, slightly smaller left/right with hitting point in the middle (mainly listen to the sound)

figures.name: The Threefold Requiem
figures.feel: Not heavy, full front/back unshakeable, slight space top/bottom, more space left/right

figures.name: The Crown in Ashes
figures.feel: Full top/bottom, large space front/back with banging, small space left/right with only slight space

figures.name: The Decay Awaited
figures.feel: Banging front/back/left/right, doll stuck when shaking top/bottom, only card sound

figures.name: The Elegiac Witness
figures.feel: Large top/bottom space, banging sound when shaking all sides, but all hitting at the top

figures.name: The Submerged Wreath
figures.feel: Very light, banging on all six sides, but one side has very large space and the other very small, big contrast, obvious box

figures.name: The Withered Innocence
figures.feel: Banging on all six sides with space, fairly even

figures.name: The Burning Gloom
figures.feel: Full on all six sides with slight space, one obvious banging point when shaking left/right but not protruding, feels relatively full and pressing

figures.name: The Vow
figures.feel: Banging on all six sides, largest space front/back, top/bottom and others slightly smaller

figures.name: The Fatal Entwining
figures.feel: Full top/bottom unshakeable, slight space all around

figures.name: The Invitation of Light
figures.feel: Slight space on all six sides with hitting

figures.name: The Fairy's Trick
figures.feel: Has accessories, full, all six sides feel hard to shake, obvious pressing at the lower middle side

figures.name: The Budding Fable
figures.feel: Very heavy, slight banging sound all around, no top/bottom space with bag packaging, feels bulging top/bottom

series.name: PUCKY|Candlelit Wander Series Figures
series.note: All figures in the series can light up

figures.name: Rise and Shine
figures.feel: Secret, no feel data yet

figures.name: Blessings From Auditorium
figures.feel: Front/back shake: heavy hitting at top of both sides with almost no desiccant sound. Left/right shake: heavy hitting at top right side with no desiccant sound. Top/bottom shake: body still, only double cards hitting (small desiccant pack)

figures.name: Moonlight Serenade
figures.feel: Front/back shake: barely moves with loud desiccant sound. Left/right shake: double cards hitting with loud desiccant sound. Top/bottom shake: body still, only double cards hitting sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Fortune's Elixir
figures.feel: Front/back shake: light hitting at lower middle front. Left/right shake: light hitting at lower left with loud desiccant sound. Top/bottom shake: body mostly still, accessories and double cards hitting with loud desiccant sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Milky Way Weaver
figures.feel: Top/bottom shake: only desiccant sound. Left/right shake: heavy hitting at top of both sides. Front/back shake: light hitting at top front with desiccant sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Starry Conductor
figures.feel: Front/back shake: slight even shaking with desiccant sound. Left/right shake: hitting at top of both sides but scattered on left. Top/bottom shake: body still, only desiccant, accessories and ID card shaking sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Runaway Princess
figures.feel: Front/back shake: heavy hitting at top back. Left/right shake: body still, only double cards hitting. Top/bottom shake: ID card hitting with loud desiccant sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Candlelit Dinner
figures.feel: Top/bottom shake: loud desiccant sound with accessory hitting. Front/back/left/right shake: hitting at top of all four sides with loose overall shaking and loud desiccant sound (large desiccant pack)

figures.name: Voyage Through Pages
figures.feel: Pick the heaviest one! Front/back shake: heavy hitting at top of both sides with almost no desiccant sound. Left/right shake: hitting at top of both sides with loud accessory hitting and no desiccant sound. Top/bottom shake: double cards and accessories hitting together (small desiccant pack)

figures.name: Wish Upon a Star
figures.feel: The heaviest in the series. Slight up-down shaking with bottom box-hitting, resistance when pressed up-down, slight front-back movement, left-right fairly full with obvious rebound when pressed. Built-in plastic shell protection, overall a big obvious box.

figures.name: Vitality of the Rabbit
figures.feel: Feels heavy. Up-down has space with bottom box-hitting, all four sides have space with dull mid-section hitting. Contains 20g large desiccant pack.

figures.name: Wisdom of the Owl
figures.feel: Overall heavy and hollow. Large up-down space with obvious bottom box-hitting, all four sides have space with even mid-section hitting. Contains 20g large desiccant pack.

figures.name: Luck of the Ladybug
figures.feel: Slight up-down shaking with bottom box-touching, limited space on four sides, hard to shake. Contains 11g desiccant.

figures.name: Wings of Beauty
figures.feel: Overall very hollow. Large space on all six sides, up-down shaking hits bottom, four-side shaking hits evenly in middle.

figures.name: Marine Friendship
figures.feel: Overall fairly full. Slight up-down shaking with accessories hitting bottom, limited space on four sides, can hear accessories when shaking.

figures.name: Arrow of Love
figures.feel: Has up-down space with bottom box-hitting, limited space on four sides, placed diagonally. Built-in plastic shell protection.

figures.name: Rebirth of the Lotus
figures.feel: Slight up-down shaking with accessories hitting bottom, all four sides have space with even mid-section hitting.

figures.name: Innocence of Snowflake
figures.feel: Very full feeling, with obvious foam sensation when pressed. Completely immovable on all six sides, puffy feeling. Built-in foam protection.

figures.name: The Guardian Gargoyle
figures.feel: Slight up-down shaking with bottom box-touching, all four sides have space with even mid-section hitting.

figures.name: Strength of the Lion
figures.feel: Overall full and tight. Cannot shake up-down, resistance in middle when pressed, front-back lower-middle presses against box, left-right middle presses against box with rebound. Built-in plastic shell protection.

figures.name: Wish of Fortune
figures.feel: Slight up-down shaking, resistance in middle when pressed, limited space on four sides with slight movement. Built-in plastic shell protection.

figures.name: Freedom of Feathers
figures.feel: The lightest in the series. Up-down shaking hits bottom, four-side shaking hits middle.

series.name: Twinkle Twinkle|Welcome to the Moon Surface Series Figures

figures.name: Cinnamon Whiskey Gelato
figures.feel: When shaking left and right, there is obvious box-hitting in the middle of the second row on the illustration side. Front and back has slight box-hitting. The hitting point is at the mouth position of Twinkle Twinkle.

figures.name: Strawberry Guava Gelato
figures.feel: Front and back only has a slight swaying feeling. Left and right also has no space, only the sound of desiccant.

figures.name: Purple Potato Gelato
figures.feel: Not much space front, back, left, or right. However, when shaking front and back, there is a box-hitting feeling at the lower back. This one needs to be distinguished.

figures.name: Unicorn Gelato
figures.feel: Not much space left and right, with slight box-touching on the right side. Front and back hits at the ice cream letters of Twinkle Twinkle.

figures.name: Mint Ice Lemon Gelato
figures.feel: Relatively fuller. No box-hitting feeling front, back, left or right - only hear card and desiccant sounds. When shaking front-back, there is slight box-hitting at the lower back position.

series.name: DIMOO|The Secret Theatre Club Series Figures
series.note: The weight difference is quite big, and the feel of the hair on the head is also different.

figures.name: Softie Sheep
figures.feel: There is only a little space on all six sides, and there is a slight shaking and impact feeling in the space. The sound on all six sides is very loud, and the sound space on all six sides is very average. It is very different from the impact and space feeling of other models.

figures.name: Chubby Penguin
figures.feel: The upper and lower space is very large, and the sound of boxes being smashed and the box being hit are loud. On the contrary, there is almost no box knocking sound from the front, rear, left, and right. There is only the sound of the desiccant shaking, and there is no obvious impact feeling of the box being hit, just a slight shaking.

figures.name: Maze Bunny
figures.feel: The space on all six sides is very large, and there is an obvious sound of metal rings hitting the front and back. Relatively speaking, the upper and lower spaces are not that big. It is slightly propped up by the top of the head. There is also a clear sound and feeling of metal shaking and hitting when shaking left and right.

figures.name: Cherry Hoglet
figures.feel: The left and right spaces feel very large and wobbly, and the desiccant shakes loudly. There is a big space above and below where the box is obviously packed, but the front and rear are very full and there is only a little space.

figures.name: Timid Lion
figures.feel: The upper and lower spaces are large and the sound of boxing is obvious. There is also an obvious sound of boxing in the left and right spaces. The front and rear are relatively full. There is an obvious sound of desiccant shaking slightly. There is a slight gap in the baby's entire body, but there is no sound.

figures.name: Granny Wolf
figures.feel: The whole one is relatively heavy. It is quite full up and down, but there is a shaking sound of the metal ring. When shaking left and right, there is an obvious box-beating sound in the upper part. The head of this one is very solid, and the front and rear space is small. The impact of the metal ring is very obvious.

series.name: Hirono|Tamed Wildgrass Series Figures
series.note: There are many easy-to-identify figures

figures.name: Camping
figures.feel: There is an obvious shaking feeling of cards when shaking around. There is no sound of the baby hitting the box. There is a slight impact feeling in the space with a small distance up and down.

figures.name: Overload
figures.feel: The whole thing is also very full, with no space at all above and below. There is only a very subtle shaking space around it, just a little bit.

figures.name: City Escape
figures.feel: There are accessories. The upper and lower heads are very high but there is a little space and the sound of the desiccant shaking. There is some space all around for the whole head to shake. It is not easy to distinguish.

figures.name: Sisyphean Work
figures.feel: It is so full that it can be pushed out immediately. It feels like the box is about to burst. It can be pushed out directly from the left and right sides. It is also full up and down, front and back, and it is easy to hold.

figures.name: Caged Bird
figures.feel: There is no space at all, no space, no space, no overturning, no overcoming, pure fullness

figures.name: Fated
figures.feel: It is protected by a plastic shell. The desiccant is very large on the side. It is not protruding but is very full and has no space.

figures.name: Full-time
figures.feel: It is quite full up and down and only shakes slightly. There is space around it, but it is light and very full. There is a small surface on the upper part that feels like a bump. There is a lot of space at the front and rear, and there is an obvious box in the middle.

figures.name: Self-Anchored
figures.feel: The whole thing is relatively full, and the baby can't shake it very well. There is only the sound of desiccant, but there is a top box. The top box is at the decorative point above the front photo. It is not the top of the baby itself, but the baby carrying the bag together. It feels very full.

figures.name: Live Under Receipts
figures.feel: When shaking from side to side, the sound at the bottom is louder. When shaking from six sides, the baby feels full and there is no space.

figures.name: Boiling Frog
figures.feel: The baby is heavy and the desiccant is large. There is room when shaking it up and down, but the sound is small but it makes a very deep muffled sound when it hits. The box is packed when it is shaken all around and the boxing point is in a circle at the lower part. It is very solid and solid, with the center at the lower part.

figures.name: Canned Dreams
figures.feel: It is almost motionless on all six sides and only slightly shakes. However, this one is solid but large and heavy, but the weight distribution feels more in the middle.

figures.name: Digital Bind
figures.feel: There is movement and box contact in all six directions. The front/back space is large, while the left/right space is extremely limited. When shaken up/down, both the card and the figure hit the box loudly.

series.name: FARMER BOB|On the Farm Series Figures
series.note: There are many easy-to-identify figures

figures.name: 仲夏夜之梦
figures.feel: What’s strange is that this one is quite full, but it’s not heavy. It’s very full up and down and front and back, and it will wobble when there’s room left and right.

figures.name: 春日柠檬
figures.feel: The six sides are very full and the baby cannot shake them, but the counterweight coins are particularly dangling inside and can be bumped around at will.

figures.name: 去抓鱼吧
figures.feel: It is a little tight up and down but can be shaken, and the accessories will hit lightly. There is only an obvious knocking sound of the counterweight coins when shaking around, and no other sounds.

figures.name: 小麦的馈赠
figures.feel: It is full on all sides (there is no space at the front and back, a little bit on the left and right and the lower part is very empty), there is a little space on the top and bottom, and it will be boxed lightly in a small area.

figures.name: 湖中朋友
figures.feel: It's full up and down, full left and right, but the front and rear space is so big that it's easy to pack, and the sound is loud and heavy.

figures.name: 春雨协奏曲
figures.feel: There is space on all six sides, and the sound of boxing on all six sides is very loud, empty, and the impact is very strong.

figures.name: 报恩萝卜
figures.feel: It's very full, with a little space on all six sides, but it's not overwhelming at all, and it feels almost silent.

figures.name: 麦田守夜人
